name: Africa Safari Adventure
why: Guide-led traverse — big cats and bigger horizons.
details: Fly into Nairobi or Kilimanjaro and chain the Serengeti, Maasai Mara, and Ngorongoro Crater with a small-group guide. Dry season lines up with the river crossings.

name: Motorcycle South America
why: Ride the Andes spine top to bottom. Pampas, Patagonia, Atacama. The classic.
details: Pick up a dual-sport in Buenos Aires or Santiago, then ride Ruta 40 and the Carretera Austral south. Six to eight weeks, shoulder-season weather.

name: Amazon Permaculture
why: Live on a permaculture farm in the jungle for a season. Learn what canopy actually means.
details: Line up a work-trade or WWOOF placement on a jungle farm and commit to a full season — long enough to watch one crop cycle through.

name: The Stans
why: Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan. Silk Road on horseback or share-taxi.
details: Fly into Bishkek, loop Kyrgyzstan's alpine lakes on horseback, then share-taxi the Pamir Highway through Tajikistan into Uzbekistan's Silk Road cities.

name: Galápagos
why: Where Darwin had the thought. Boobies, iguanas, hammerheads.
details: Book a small liveaboard out of Santa Cruz or San Cristóbal — seven or eight days reaches the outer islands and the hammerhead dives.

name: New Zealand Hiking
why: Routeburn + Milford Tracks. Land of the Long White Cloud.
details: Book Routeburn and Milford Track huts the morning they open, months ahead, then string them together on the South Island in summer.

name: Australia Mini-Van Living
why: East coast in a Wicked van. Bondi to the Whitsundays.
details: Grab a campervan in Sydney and run the coast north to Cairns over a month, diving the reef along the way.

name: Bali
why: To escape my life and eat fruit.
details: Base in Ubud for the fruit, the rice terraces, and zero fixed itinerary. That's the whole plan.

name: Costa Rica
details: Pacific coast for the surf, Monteverde cloud forest for the green. Rent a 4x4 and keep it loose.
